title: Foreign Movie Posters
description: FOREIGN MOVIE POSTERS often use different art than the domestic one-sheets, or art that hasn't been widely seen. The painting by Tom Cantrell (front) was used on one STAR WARS poster in the U.S., but wasn't printed in large quantities. However, because it shows more action and gunplay than the Tom Jung or Hildebrandt brothers' artwork, it was in great demand for foreign posters such as one from Hong Kong (back).
